carryon_allowance.value: One piece of carry-on luggage and one personal item (e.g. handbag, laptop bag); it must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat.
carryon_allowance.notes: The same page says carry-on weight is 'generally limited to 7kg'; the hedged figure is not published.

max_bag_weight.value: The maximum weight for a single checked bag is 32kg; bags over this limit may not be accepted.
max_bag_weight.notes: The page describes the standard allowance only in hedged terms ('usually 23kg per bag'), so no allowance is published.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in is available from 24 hours up until 3 hours before scheduled departure; it is not available on Air Niugini flights originating from Australia and Japan. After checking in online, report 90 minutes before departure with baggage, or 60 minutes without, for document checks.

counter_open.value: Check-in counters open 2 hours before departure for domestic flights and 3 hours before for international flights.

checkin_close.value: Check-in closes 45 minutes before departure; boarding time is 30 minutes before departure.

fail_to_board.value: A passenger who has checked in (online or at the counter) and then fails to board has the ticket forfeited; this applies to Economy and Business class tickets.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed in Air Niugini's conditions of carriage page, with other office numbers.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.
